title: Claude Code plugin manifest
description: The .claude-plugin/plugin.json lint accepts. It is the metadata and skill pointer this plugin ships, not the whole Claude Code surface: the flow lives in SKILL.md, so a manifest-only part (commands, hooks, MCP wiring) stays rejected until the intent allows it.

$schema.description: Editor hint; ignored when the manifest is loaded.

name.description: Kebab-case plugin identifier; namespaces the plugin's skills.

description.description: One-line, user-facing account of what the plugin provides.

skills.description: Skill directories relative to the plugin root; each holds a SKILL.md.
